pages.text: $(l)Skip or delay these to avoid wasted effort$()$(li)$(l)Delay making Hint of Insanity$() until you have Berserker Forge access (requires Berserker Steel); Hellfire Forges are inefficient without automation setup.

$(li)$(l)Don’t prioritize dedicated beryllium production early$()—it’s produced as a byproduct of NaK processing.$(li)$(l)Skip early Roosts$()—a single Roost is about half the speed of a Mechanized Coop; go straight to multi-block roosts for high-tier chickens.
$(li)$(l)Skip non-Advanced Torcherinos$()—only the Advanced version exists in-game, and it’s already strong enough.

$(li)$(l)Don’t farm Taint Seeds by placing them near blocks that can become tainted$()—taint spreads even from partially infected blocks; use Silk Quarry or Builder quarry on a captured seed over dirt instead.

$(li)$(l)Don’t rely on JEI alone for Nebulous Hearts$()—the Abyss Table recipe (in the Abyss dimension) is valid and recommended, while JEI only shows the Mythical Miner path.$(li)$(l)Don’t kill Wrought Crabs with non-pickaxe tools$()—only pickaxe kills drop the puzzle item;
other methods (e.g., Liquid Death) yield only the item tag.

$(li)$(l)Skip bone mining for Prescia Bone Horn components$()—Bone Bits can be obtained from Shell resources (e.g., chickens).$(li)$(l)Skip early dedicated Barathos Hive Spawner hunting$()—the structure is located inside a huge hollow hill, so surface scanning is unnecessary.

$(li)$(l)Skip trying to fit Tesseractors inside boxes$() behind bedrock slabs—use Terra Shatterer, Awakened Ichorium Pick (Square Mode), Red Morning Star, or a Magnet/Item Collector instead.$(li)$(l)Delay Dragonsteel maintenance$() until Lattice production is needed;
minimal upkeep is fine while focusing on other Draconic Evolution stages.
